subject.title: feat(android): server-backed session search with offline fallback

question: Should Android chat model selection be enabled by granting or upgrading `operator.admin` tokens, or should the model picker stay hidden behind a scope-aware reauth path when the stored operator token lacks admin?
rationale: The PR mixes a user-facing model picker with persisted operator-token scope behavior and an Android admin-scope expansion, so automation should not choose the permanent authorization boundary.

options.title: Gate And Reauth Before Selection
options.body: Hide or disable model selection unless the active operator session has admin, and provide an in-product reauth/token-upgrade path for older stored tokens.

options.title: Accept Admin Operator Tokens
options.body: Explicitly accept that Android UI operator sessions may carry admin scope and add upgrade proof for stored-token installs before merge.

options.title: Split Model Authorization Out
options.body: Keep the session-search PR focused and move Android model-picker authorization to a separate PR with its own security review.

recommendation.title: Gate And Reauth Before Selection
recommendation.body: Hide or disable model selection unless the active operator session has admin, and provide an in-product reauth/token-upgrade path for older stored tokens.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the stacked session-management direction and authored the Android model-picker, gateway scope, and search commits involved in this decision.
